resume_rule: Explicit --resume only: next unstarted cell in battery order; COMPLETE, RED and STARTED_UNFINISHED cells never retried. Unfinished cells remain charged 285s. An unmet persist dependency makes the next cell RED without a worker, never recapture. First newly observed RED stops. Previously recorded RED scores remain immutable on resume; final summary remains RED. A campaign mutex prevents concurrent controllers.
